name: Page Speed Script Optimizer
author: WP Craftbench

sections.description:
Page Speed Script Optimizer helps you optimize your WordPress site performance by selectively loading plugins only where they’re actually needed. Instead of loading all plugins on every page, you can create conditions to exclude heavy plugins from specific pages, improving load times and Core Web Vitals.

Key Features:
* Create plugin loading conditions
* Multiple plugins per condition (exclude mode)
* Pages-based targeting
* Easy-to-use interface with visual condition management
* Basic performance optimization for simple use cases

How It Works:
1. Create a condition (e.g., “Exclude heavy plugins from key pages”)
2. Select multiple plugins to exclude from loading
3. Choose up to 3 pages where the condition applies
4. Save your targeted optimization

Pro Version Available:
For advanced features like unlimited conditions, include/exclude modes, and categories/tags targeting, check out Page Speed Script Optimizer Pro.

External services

This plugin does not connect to any external services or third-party APIs. All functionality operates locally within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/page-speed-script-optimizer/ directory, or install through WordPress admin
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Script Optimizer in your WordPress admin to create your first condition
  4. Select plugins to conditionally load and choose target pages
  5. Save your condition and enjoy improved performance!
sections.faq:
How many conditions can I create?

The Lite version includes basic conditional loading functionality. Pro version offers unlimited conditions and advanced targeting options.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro?

  • Lite: Basic conditional loading with pages targeting
  • Pro: Advanced features including unlimited conditions, include/exclude modes, categories & tags targeting

Will this break my site?

The plugin is designed to be safe. However, always test conditions on a staging site first, especially when excluding plugins that provide critical functionality.

Can I target categories and tags?

Categories and tags targeting is available in the Pro version. The Lite version supports pages targeting.

Can I use include mode in Lite?

Include mode is available in the Pro version. Lite version focuses on exclude mode functionality.

How does the targeting work?

You can exclude plugins from specific pages to improve performance on key pages like homepage and checkout.

Does this work with caching plugins?

Yes! The plugin works at the WordPress core level and is compatible with most caching solutions.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

All plugins will load normally as if the conditions never existed. Your site functionality will be fully restored.
